006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.AbstractDurationAdapter;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.TypeConstants;
013
014import java.time.temporal.TemporalAmount;
015
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * An atomic Metapath item representing a duration data value.
020 * <p>
021 * This interface supports both day-time and year-month duration formats
022 * following the ISO 8601 standard. Examples of valid durations include:
023 * <ul>
024 * <li>P1Y2M (1 year, 2 months)
025 * <li>P3DT4H5M (3 days, 4 hours, 5 minutes)
026 * </ul>
027 *
028 * @see IDayTimeDurationItem
029 * @see IYearMonthDurationItem
030 */
031public interface IDurationItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
032  /**
033   * Get the type information for this item.
034   *
035   * @return the type information
036   */
037  @NonNull
038  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDurationItem> type() {
039    return TypeConstants.DURATION_TYPE;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Construct a new duration item using the provided string {@code value}.
044   *
045   * @param value
046   *          a string representing a day time duration
047   * @return the new item
048   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
049   *           if the provided string value is not a year/month or day/time
050   *           duration value according to ISO 8601
051   */
052  @NonNull
053  static IDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
054    try {
055      return AbstractDurationAdapter.parseDuration(value);
056    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
057      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
058          null,
059          String.format("Invalid year/month or day/time duration value '%s'.",
060              value),
061          ex);
062    }
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
067   *
068   * @param item
069   *          the item to cast
070   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
071   *         cast to this type
072   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
073   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
074   */
075  @NonNull
076  static IDurationItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
077    IDurationItem retval;
078    if (item instanceof IDurationItem) {
079      retval = (IDurationItem) item;
080    } else {
081      String value;
082      try {
083        value = item.asString();
084      } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
085        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
086        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
087      }
088
089      try {
090        retval = valueOf(value);
091      } catch (InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
092        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
093            String.format("Value '%s' cannot be parsed as either a day-time or year-month duration", value),
094            ex);
095      }
096    }
097    return retval;
098  }
099
100  @Override
101  TemporalAmount getValue();
102
103  @Override
104  default IDurationItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
105    return cast(item);
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Compares this value with the argument.
110   *
111   * @param item
112   *          the item to compare with this value
113   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
114   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
115   */
116  int compareTo(@NonNull IDurationItem item);
117}
